title: Stellar Nullius
body:
![Stellar Nullius - Decorative Demo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/191ce5c411168abafc132b00418cfda86ed5be14.png)
Introducing Stellar Nullius: a mod about interstellar travel in style. Explore an expansive universe with gameplay inspired by both Prey and No Man's Sky with infinite possibilities and secrets in every nook and cranny.

Currently a demo: Contains a selection of woods, stones, metals, and decorative blocks, but no rocketry. Sorry.
